items.text: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here’s why
items.article: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis. Friday's weaker-than-expected jobs report may feel especially lousy for men. Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to an analysis of government data by Indeed. That's the longest stretch since 2010, the job search platform found. "Back then, the gap emerged because men were losing jobs," said Cory Stahle, senior economist at Indeed. "This time, it's because women are gaining them." Across the board, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said Friday that U.S. payrolls grew by 29,000 jobs on net in September, lower than economists consensus forecast for an increase of 84,000. Men represented slightly over half of net job growth in September, according to a CNBC analysis of Friday's BLS data. A month prior, men represented just 2% of payroll growth. Despite the monthly increase, the seasonally adjusted number of employed men in the U.S. was lower by about 1.2 million in September compared with a year ago. Women's employment rose by more than 650,000 in the same period.

items.article: Ayaneo’s Konkr Pocket Advance resurrects and upgrades the Game Boy Advance with a larger screen, extra buttons, and more capabilities. It’s a faithful Game Boy Advance clone, but the Pocket Advance runs Android, so you can play more than just GBA games. Although I count the original Game Boy as one of my first tech obsessions, I still consider Nintendo’s Game Boy Advance to be my favorite console of all time thanks to its more comfortable horizontal design (for my big hands) and its expansive catalog of excellent 32-bit and 16-bit games. Ayaneo isn’t the first company to attempt to modernize the GBA, but its Konkr Pocket Advance does it best. The handheld strikes a near perfect balance between authentically re-creating the GBA’s design while updating its hardware with new controls, a much better screen, and the flexibility of Android at a price that feels like a bargain. As much as I still adore the GBA, I’ve eagerly embraced upgrades to the aging console over the years. items.article: Dhriti Reddy studied entrepreneurship at Woxsen University before becoming a commercial pilot with IndiGo. I was fascinated by airplanes, the cockpit and the pilots. While most passengers looked forward to reaching their destination, I found myself fascinated by the aircraft itself and the professionalism of the cockpit crew. By the age of 13, I had made a firm decision: one day, I would become a pilot. What I did not know then was that the journey to the cockpit would not be a straight line. My undergraduate degree was in Business Management, specialising in Entrepreneurship Development, a field that, at first glance, seems far removed from aviation. At the western end sits the I-395 Signature Bridge, six concrete arches that were meant to “redefine the Miami skyline.” The state awarded the contract to build in 2017; the project is now expected to be completed sometime in 2029. Over this period, the price has climbed from $802 million to $866 million. The contractor is suing its own designer and insurer for $400 million. A worker died on the job in March, two months after six others were hospitalized. Only four of the six arches are standing.

items.text: 5 sarees from West Bengal to add to your Durga Puja wardrobe
items.article: Besides being a festival of faiths, feasts and festivities, Durga Puja is also an exhibition of Bengali culture and craft. Dressing up in Bengali sarees cannot be replaced by anything else for this very reason! Be it the comfort of Tant or the luxury of Baluchari, Bengali traditional wear encapsulates Bengali ethos perfectly. So if you are going to celebrate Saptami, Ashtami, Navami or Dashami this year, take a close look at 5 traditional Bengali sarees from Bengal that you would not want to miss! If there's one saree that instantly transports you to a Bengali celebration, it's the Tant saree. Traditionally handmade from cotton, this saree is perfect for those blistering hot Puja days. The ever-so-classic white and red border tant saree is a must-have in any Bengali woman's festive wardrobe, especially during Durga puja. But, nowadays, tant sarees come in all shades of the rainbow! Garad saree is a traditional drape worn by Bengalis during festivals. This traditional Bengali piece features a simple white or off-white saree with red borders and pallu, which has been worn during religious festivals and Bengali rituals.
